script:
import frappe from frappe import _ from frappe.utils import flt, cstr @frappe.whitelist() def extract_materials_from_boms(doc_name): """ Extract all materials from BOMs listed in BoQ table """ try: doc = frappe.get_doc("Job Estimation", doc_name) # Clear existing materials doc.materials = [] # Dictionary to consolidate materials consolidated_materials = {} # Process each BoQ item for boq_item in doc.boq: if not boq_item.bom: continue # Get BOM materials bom_materials = get_bom_materials(boq_item.bom, boq_item.entity_from_site_dim) # Consolidate materials for material in bom_materials: item_key = material['item_code'] if item_key in consolidated_materials: # Fix: Use regular assignment instead of augmented assignment consolidated_materials[item_key]['required_qty'] = consolidated_materials[item_key]['required_qty'] + material['required_qty'] consolidated_materials[item_key]['amount'] = consolidated_materials[item_key]['amount'] + material['amount'] else: consolidated_materials[item_key] = material # Add consolidated materials to document for item_code, material_data in consolidated_materials.items(): doc.append("materials", material_data) # Save document doc.save() frappe.msgprint( f"Successfully extracted {len(consolidated_materials)} unique materials from {len([b for b in doc.boq if b.bom])} BOMs", title="Materials Extracted" ) return len(consolidated_materials) except Exception as e: frappe.throw(f"Error extracting materials: {str(e)}") def get_bom_materials(bom_no, source_entity): """ Get all materials from a BOM with explosion """ materials = [] # Get BOM document bom_doc = frappe.get_doc("BOM", bom_no) # Process BOM items for bom_item in bom_doc.items: # Check if item has its own BOM (sub-assembly) item_bom = frappe.db.get_value("BOM", {"item": bom_item.item_code, "is_active": 1, "is_default": 1}, "name" ) if item_bom: # Recursive call for sub-assembly sub_materials = get_bom_materials(item_bom, source_entity) for sub_material in sub_materials: # Fix: Use regular assignment instead of augmented assignment sub_material['required_qty'] = sub_material['required_qty'] * bom_item.qty sub_material['amount'] = sub_material['required_qty'] * sub_material['rate'] materials.append(sub_material) else: # Direct material materials.append({ 'item_code': bom_item.item_code, 'item_name': bom_item.item_name, 'required_qty': bom_item.qty, 'uom': bom_item.uom, 'rate': bom_item.rate or 0, 'amount': (bom_item.qty * (bom_item.rate or 0)), 'source_bom': bom_no, 'source_entity': source_entity, 'include_in_mr': 0 }) return materials @frappe.whitelist() def check_material_availability(doc_name): """ Check availability of all materials in the estimation """ try: doc = frappe.get_doc("Job Estimation", doc_name) if not doc.materials: frappe.throw("No materials found. Please extract materials from BOMs first.") total_items = len(doc.materials) available_items = 0 total_cost = 0 for material in doc.materials: # Get available stock available_qty = get_available_stock(material.item_code) material.available_qty = available_qty # Calculate shortage required_qty = material.required_qty or 0 short_qty = max(0, required_qty - available_qty) material.short_qty = short_qty # Set availability status if available_qty >= required_qty: material.availability_status = "Available" available_items += 1 material.include_in_mr = 0 elif available_qty > 0: material.availability_status = "Partial" material.include_in_mr = 1 else: material.availability_status = "Not Available" material.include_in_mr = 1 total_cost += material.amount or 0 # Update summary availability_percent = (available_items / total_items * 100) if total_items > 0 else 0 doc.material_availability_percent = availability_percent doc.total_material_cost = total_cost doc.save() short_items = total_items - available_items frappe.msgprint( f"Material availability check completed:
" f"Available: {available_items} items ({availability_percent:.1f}%)
" f"Short: {short_items} items
" f"Total Cost: {frappe.utils.fmt_money(total_cost)}", title="Availability Check Results" ) return { 'total_items': total_items, 'available_items': available_items, 'availability_percent': availability_percent } except Exception as e: frappe.throw(f"Error checking availability: {str(e)}") def get_available_stock(item_code, warehouse=None): """ Get available stock quantity for an item """ filters = {"item_code": item_code} if warehouse: filters["warehouse"] = warehouse result = frappe.db.sql(""" SELECT SUM(actual_qty) as available_qty FROM `tabBin` WHERE item_code = %(item_code)s {warehouse_condition} AND actual_qty > 0 """.format( warehouse_condition="AND warehouse = %(warehouse)s" if warehouse else "" ), filters, as_dict=True) return result[0].available_qty if result and result[0].available_qty else 0 @frappe.whitelist() def create_material_request(doc_name): """ Create Material Request for items marked for purchase """ try: doc = frappe.get_doc("Job Estimation", doc_name) # Get items to be requested items_for_mr = [m for m in doc.materials if m.include_in_mr and m.short_qty > 0] if not items_for_mr: frappe.msgprint("No items selected for Material Request", title="Nothing to Request") return # Create Material Request mr = frappe.new_doc("Material Request") mr.material_request_type = "Purchase" mr.schedule_date = doc.estimated_start_date or frappe.utils.add_days(frappe.utils.nowdate(), 7) mr.company = frappe.defaults.get_user_default("Company") or frappe.db.get_single_value("Global Defaults", "default_company") # Add custom field to link back to Job Estimation if hasattr(mr, 'custom_job_estimation'): mr.custom_job_estimation = doc.name # Add items for material in items_for_mr: mr.append("items", { "item_code": material.item_code, "qty": material.short_qty, "uom": material.uom, "schedule_date": mr.schedule_date, "warehouse": get_default_warehouse(), "rate": material.rate, "amount": material.short_qty * (material.rate or 0) }) # Insert Material Request mr.insert() # Update items to reflect MR creation for material in items_for_mr: material.include_in_mr = 0 doc.save() # Add comment doc.add_comment("Info", f"Material Request {mr.name} created for {len(items_for_mr)} items") frappe.msgprint( f"Material Request created successfully!
" f"Document: {mr.name}
" f"Items: {len(items_for_mr)} items", title="Material Request Created" ) return mr.name except Exception as e: frappe.throw(f"Error creating Material Request: {str(e)}") def get_default_warehouse(): """ Get default warehouse for material requests """ warehouse = frappe.db.get_single_value("Stock Settings", "default_warehouse") if not warehouse: # Get first active warehouse warehouse = frappe.db.get_value("Warehouse", {"is_group": 0, "disabled": 0}, "name") return warehouse

".join(messages), title="Employee Booking Creation Result")

# Server Script for Customer - Event: Before Save
# This script handles naming series and updates lead_name when customer is created from lead

# Set naming series if not already set
if not doc.naming_series:
    doc.naming_series = "CUST-.YYYY.-"

# Check if this customer is being created from a lead
if doc.is_new() and not doc.lead_name:
    # Try to find the lead that created this customer
    try:
        # Search for lead with matching customer reference
        lead = frappe.db.get_value("Lead", 
                                  {"customer": doc.name}, 
                                  ["name", "lead_name"], 
                                  as_dict=True)
        
        if lead:
            doc.lead_name = lead.name
            print(f"Updated customer {doc.name} with lead_name: {lead.name}")
        else:
            # Alternative: Search by customer_name matching lead_name or company_name
            lead_by_name = frappe.db.get_value("Lead", 
                                              {"lead_name": doc.customer_name}, 
                                              ["name"], 
                                              as_dict=True)
            
            if not lead_by_name:
                lead_by_name = frappe.db.get_value("Lead", 
                                                  {"company_name": doc.customer_name}, 
                                                  ["name"], 
                                                  as_dict=True)
            
            if lead_by_name:
                doc.lead_name = lead_by_name.name
                print(f"Updated customer {doc.name} with lead_name: {lead_by_name.name}")
                
    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(f"Error updating customer lead_name: {str(e)}")
        print(f"Error updating customer lead_name: {str(e)}")
